entries.title: The Great Migration
entries.description: Successfully migrated all 827 sprites onto the local server! Now modd can't ruin our game. If you see issues, please contact @thw0k on the Plants vs. Zombies: Roam Discord Server!

entries.title: Zen Garden Fix no.2
entries.description: Fixed the Zen Garden again! Obtain sprouts by buying them or from killing zombies! Grow your sprouts to earn coins, and play as special plants!

entries.title: JSON Touch-ups
entries.description: Carefully editd the JSON file to give some Plants buffs and nerfs - it's like two or three changes in damage.

entries.title: Spawn Fixing
entries.description: Fixed special spawns for previous and future event modes - everything and anything will spawn now!

entries.title: Greeting the Guests
entries.description: Fixed an issue where Guests couldn't join due to an invalidated token.
